sourceProvenance.title: Se Essa Rua Fosse Minha
sourceProvenance.edition: Independent Pianify notation of the familiar minor-mode melody; three traditional stanzas represented by deterministic repetition; Pianify editorial harmony v1
sourceProvenance.license: Public Domain (traditional song documented in the nineteenth century)
normalization: The first sounding note is normalized to 0 seconds.
Exact simultaneous duplicate pitches are reduced to one note.
Repeated pitches are separated by a 20 ms release gap when the source sustain overlaps the next attack.
No pitch is transposed and no source note is removed to fit the visual keyboard.

crossCheckReferences.role: official municipal educational material explicitly marks the song as Dominio Publico
secondary pointer to the 1884 record of verses collected in 1880; used only for historical cross-check
